title: Grilled Sweet Potatoes
blurb: The cilantro-lime dressing goes on after grilling, not before, so it stays bright instead of scorching on the grates.
steps: Prepare a grill for hot, direct heat.
Peel the sweet potatoes and slice lengthwise, or on a diagonal, into 1/4-inch-thick pieces. Coat with olive oil and lightly sprinkle with kosher salt.
Combine the cilantro, lime zest, lime juice, olive oil and a pinch of salt in a small bowl to make the dressing.
Lay the sweet potato pieces on the hot grill. Cover and cook until each side gets some grill marks, 3 to 6 minutes per side depending on how hot the grill is.
Toss the grilled sweet potatoes with the dressing in a bowl and serve hot.
